blurb: The Rookery Golf Club offers a public golf course with bent grass greens, tees, and fairways. Guests can book tee times and enjoy golf instruction from PGA certified professionals. Memberships are available but currently sold out for 2026, with a waitlist option.
extraNote: 48 hours notice required for tee time cancellations or changes · Military with ID gets $10 off 18 holes and cart, $5 off 9 holes and cart in season · Military with ID gets $5 off 18 holes and cart during offseason
